notes.title: V1.0.3: Workshop fix & optimization
notes.content:
Fixed:
[list]
[*]Level screenshot for Workshop was not created every time. Now it's fixed size, no more screen flickering when level was uploading to Workshop.
[*]small performance optimization
[/list]

PS: Did you check the new level in the Workshop: Eye Blender?

notes.title: V1.0.2: Small Additions & Bugfixes
notes.content:
Added:
[list]
[*] player level-end animation
[*] larger sidescroll area, so you can now scroll the level easier
[/list]
Fixed:
[list]
[*] secondary levels were loaded as custom levels in some cases
[/list]

notes.title: V1.0.1: Workshop Support and Cloud Saves!
notes.content:
Added:
[list]
[*]Steam Workshop support: create and share your levels on Steam Workshop!
[*]Cloud Saves: start your game/level on one computer/platform and finish on another!
[/list]

Fixed:
[list]
[*]sometimes platforms were remaining lit
[*]performance drops on lower-end computers
[*]fixed tutorial
[/list]
